[8PM] #Ikorodu #TrafficUpdate

Vehicular traffic from Ragolis towards Benson and Ikorodu interchange is moving appreciably, while journey inward Ojubode is a little busy, due to pedestrians crossing and commercial activities. 

Better movement inward Palace and Ojogbe. Return trip to Ojubode is steady moving. 

Ojubode en route LG, Ladega to Itunmoja is light. Fast moving traffic towards Itunpate and Itunmeko, Otaona. 

Otaona to connect Mobil, Water corporation and Grammar school is good to go. Further movement inward Erunwen, Radio and Itamaga is free moving. 

From Ikorodu interchange to Aleje is light, while inward Sabo to Ile-epo Oba is encouraging. 

Navigating inward LASTMA yard, Sawmill, Okegbegun is in good shape. Steady movement when moving down to First and Second gate. 

Better movement towards Flower and Jendol. While further movement is busy moving down to Odogunyan proper.
